sections.markdown:
## F — Research index and VERIFY list: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration
Knowledge index: part C contains 69 original fact blocks across 1 chunks; part C2 contains 102 continuation fact blocks across 2 chunks, all from this section’s mapped physical pages.
Authority and exam facts are located in A.01; audience in B.01; accuracy limits in D.01; demand and competitor gaps in E.01 and E2.01.
VERIFY list:
Accepted inventory: 69 C facts; 102 C2 facts; 9 typed debts; ids DE-EQUIPMENT-COUNT, DE-EQUIPMENT-PASS, DE-EQUIPMENT-TIME, DE-EQUIPMENT-CADENCE, DE-EQUIPMENT-COVER, DE-EQUIPMENT-TINT, DE-EQUIPMENT-INSPECTION, DE-EQUIPMENT-MARKET, DE-EQUIPMENT-TEARDOWN.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-COUNT: The handbook does not state the knowledge-test question count; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a count.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-PASS: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test passing percentage or passing score; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a threshold.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-TIME: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test time limit; do not substitute the road-exam duration.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-CADENCE: The snapshot is dated July on the front cover; the frequency of handbook revision was not independently verified.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-COVER: The extracted cover text carries the edition but not the graphical title or issuer; the issuer is established separately by frontmatter and the official linking page.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-TINT: The detailed equipment subsection provides a side-window waiver while the inspection checklist states a blanket tint restriction; the windshield AS-1 wording also says masking. Preserve this source ambiguity rather than inventing a unified exception.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-INSPECTION: The diesel model-year wording and the newer-vehicle renewal-period wording are not sufficiently clear to infer the complete eligibility table. Withhold those inferred boundaries and seek issuer clarification.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-MARKET: market pack requires sourced recon.
- DE-EQUIPMENT-TEARDOWN: competitive teardown requires sourced inspection.
Dynamic isolation: Contact details and mutable service/provider information remain outside stable facts; monetary and numerical rules are stated only as source-edition facts.
